decision: Make ordinary Kitty menu launches enable its existing IBus client, and retain the setting for subsequent desktop logins.
reason: Remote KDE Kitty 0.21.2 launched by the user has no GLFW_IM_MODULE. The native fixture explicitly supplied ibus, so its Tab PASS did not certify the ordinary launcher. Upstream Kitty requires GLFW_IM_MODULE=ibus for X11 IME.
verification: 4 disposable-profile checks PASS. Remote KDE native normal desktop-command launch without injected GLFW: before setup FAIL (literal tab), after setup PASS (пров -> проверка , 2.04 ms), same installed v3 bytes. Receipts kitty-menu-before-setup-v1 and kitty-menu-after-setup-v1; desktop-launch.json pins resolved installed entry. Visual prefix remains FAIL. KDE menu cache refresh succeeds; installer and uninstall refresh it when available.
not_tested: No claim for the existing user process, Wayland clients, universal prefix styling, correction or complete browser/terminal matrices.

consequences.owner: Existing installer and the application IBus client; no replacement text executor, owner, input transport or IME route.
consequences.scope: A user desktop-entry override preserves original arguments and actions. environment.d and Plasma env scripts supply only an unset GLFW_IM_MODULE default on subsequent login. Explicit other IME/custom managed-path files cause an error before modification. Uninstall removes only owned defaults and its exact launcher prefix. No live environment import into another display, user window restart or IBus restart.
consequences.rollback: Run the owned helper with --remove; preserve user edits and unrelated settings.
